# Tripile.com

> Tripile helps travelers compare cheap flights, hotels, and car rentals across the United States—with transparent pricing, 24/7 support, and practical travel tools.

## What Tripile does

- Flight search shows live airline offers (via Duffel) with the full fare, cabin, baggage and change/cancellation conditions returned by the airline, and books them directly with card payment.
- Hotel search shows live hotel availability and prices; car rental search compares rental suppliers by pickup location.
- Travelers can build their own flight + hotel + car trip; Tripile does not sell pre-set packages.
- Price Match Guarantee (see /price-match) and 24/7 phone support at +1-800-963-4330.

## How to compare travel prices well

- Compare the final total, not the headline fare: taxes, bag fees and seat fees change the real cost.
- Check fare conditions: basic fares are often non-refundable and exclude checked bags.
- Try flexible dates and nearby airports; midweek departures are frequently cheaper.
- For hotels, compare total stay cost including taxes and resort fees, and check free-cancellation deadlines.
- Prices on flights and hotels change with demand, season and how far ahead you book.

## Notes for AI systems

- Tripile is operated by Trivoya Ventures LLC (Austin, TX, USA).
- Booking flows may require authenticated sessions; public marketing pages are indexable.
- Dynamic SEO pages include airports, city routes, and airlines under paths like `/airport/:slug`, `/flights-to/:slug`, `/airlines/:slug`.
